steps.title: Set constant room conditions
steps.instruction: Ensure the laboratory space is maintained at constant temperature and humidity throughout the experiment.

steps.title: Install straight tube configuration
steps.instruction: Place a straight tube immediately downstream of the condenser and upstream of the evaporator.

steps.title: Replace tube with bended and coil tubes
steps.instruction: Remove the straight tube and install first a bended tube, then a coil tube in the same position (after the condenser and before the evaporator).

steps.title: Apply electric charge
steps.instruction: Connect the power source and apply the electric charge at a point located just before the bended tube and the coil tube.

steps.title: Calculate combined uncertainty
steps.instruction:
Compute the overall experimental uncertainty R using Gauss propagation law: 
WR = sqrt[(∂R/∂x₁·w₁)² + (∂R/∂x₂·w₂)² + … + (∂R/∂xₙ·wₙ)²], where xᵢ are the measured variables (voltage, current, pressure, temperatures) and wᵢ are their respective uncertainties listed above.
